description: Use when the question spans several sites and you need one action per site instead of one call per site. Give 1-10 siteIds; returns the highest-scored open opportunity for each site, ranked across sites, with that site's open count, last-sync time and a per-site status. Reads the durable opportunity library only (the same scores the console Now queue shows) - no GSC, audit or competitor recomputation, no vendor calls, no writes. A site that was never synced is reported as not-synced and a site with no open rows as empty; neither is reported as a zero-opportunity success. Unknown, foreign and competitor site ids come back as not-found. Read-only; requires the audit:read scope.

siteIds.description: 1-10 site ids from list_sites (owned sites only)

name: list_portfolio_opportunities
title: Ranked top opportunity across several sites
